name: io.github.GermaniU/ga4-seo-mcp
title: GA4 SEO MCP
description: Set up and audit site measurement: GA4, Search Console and PageSpeed. Read-only unless enabled.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Path to a service account key file. Leave unset to use Application Default Credentials from gcloud.

environmentVariables.name: GA4SEO_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register tools that create, update, delete, submit or verify. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: PAGESPEED_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PageSpeed Insights API key. Recommended: the anonymous quota is shared and often exhausted.

environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: DataForSEO login, for the dataforseo toolset.

environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: DataForSEO password, for the dataforseo toolset.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google Ads developer token, for the ads toolset.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Manager (MCC) customer ID, only when operating through a manager account.

runtimeArguments.name: --volume
runtimeArguments.description: Mount your credentials file (gcloud ADC or a service account key) read-only.

credentials_file.description: Host path of the credentials JSON, usually ~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json.

runtimeArguments.name: --user
runtimeArguments.description: Run as your own uid:gid so the container can read a 0600 credentials file.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Path of the mounted credentials file inside the container.

environmentVariables.name: GA4SEO_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register tools that create, update, delete, submit or verify. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: PAGESPEED_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PageSpeed Insights API key. Recommended: the anonymous quota is shared and often exhausted.

environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: DataForSEO login, for the dataforseo toolset.

environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: DataForSEO password, for the dataforseo toolset.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google Ads developer token, for the ads toolset.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Manager (MCC) customer ID, only when operating through a manager account.
